errors.evidence: The description incorrectly states that the horizontal axis has intervals of 1%. Based on the ten gridlines shown, the intervals are 2%.
This phrase describes the range of the data values presented in the chart, not the range of the horizontal axis itself. The axis scale extends beyond 19%, likely to 20% as suggested by the gridlines.

The description fails to explain the significance of the two colors used for the bars. It notes the colors exist but claims their meaning is not specified, missing the clear pattern where red bars represent values of 10% or greater and blue bars represent values below 10%. This color coding is a key feature for visually grouping the data.
